rows.title: The broker adapter interface
rows.defect: getOrderStatus is wired to the client-id lookup
rows.test: getOrderStatus reads the order by its id

rows.title: Connect sends the person to the broker's page, and only that
rows.defect: the client secret is put in the authorize URL
rows.test: no secret in the approval URL

rows.title: The OAuth round trip, server side
rows.defect: the code is exchanged as JSON, which Alpaca's token endpoint does not accept

rows.title: A tampered state is rejected
rows.defect: the state's signature is not checked
rows.test: another person's id under the old signature is refused

rows.title: An expired state is rejected
rows.defect: the state's expiry is not checked
rows.test: a state 10 minutes old connects nothing

rows.title: A state is used once
rows.defect: the nonce's single use is not enforced

rows.title: Live only, no paper fallback
rows.defect: a refused live account read falls through to a generic failure
rows.test: a token that opens no live account connects nothing

rows.title: One account, one login
rows.defect: the conflict is reported as a save failure
rows.test: an account someone else holds is refused and said

rows.title: Honest when Connect can't run
rows.defect: a missing client secret is not noticed
rows.test: no client secret means not switched on

rows.title: No secret in any log, redirect or message
rows.defect: the callback logs its query string
rows.test: the code never reaches a log line

rows.title: No brokerage: the honest connect prompt
rows.defect: the connect prompt is skipped and a generic block is said
rows.test: an order with nothing connected gets the prompt

rows.title: No public API, said plainly
rows.defect: brokers with no public API are not recognized
rows.test: Robinhood and Fidelity are said plainly

rows.title: Revoked or expired: Reconnect
rows.defect: a refused token is reported as a broker outage

rows.title: The $5.00 per-order cap
rows.defect: the adapter sends without checking the cap
rows.test: the adapter refuses an order over the cap

rows.title: No order without approval
rows.defect: a T3 order is treated as not needing a confirmation
rows.test: nothing is sent before the yes

rows.title: Cross-person isolation end to end
rows.defect: rows are not checked against the caller

rows.title: The callback never completes a connection by itself
rows.defect: the callback confirms the staged connection itself, for whoever started it
